reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g2_mg_q4_1), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The samples directly address both reading and writing/setting time in hours and minutes with a.m. and p.m. designations on an analog clock. Reading is assessed via questions asking "What time does the clock show?" while setting/writing time is evaluated with tasks such as "Set the clock to show 9:40 a.m." and "Set the clock to show 9:45 p.m.".

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample set provides balanced coverage across different times of day (a.m. and p.m.) and varying minute intervals, including 5-minute increments ("Set the clock to show 12:05 a.m."), 15-minute intervals ("Set the clock to show 3:15 p.m."), 30-minute intervals ("Set the clock to show 11:30 a.m."), 40-minute intervals ("Set the clock to show 9:40 a.m."), and 45-minute intervals ("Set the clock to show 11:45 a.m.").

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The language and task complexity are completely aligned with Grade 2 Quarter 4 developmental abilities. Direct, simple prompts such as "What time does the clock show?" and "Set the clock to show 3:30 p.m." minimize cognitive reading overhead, allowing students to focus purely on the target time-telling skills.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The items test bidirectional competency across multiple formats: read_mcq for visual decoding of analog clock faces ("What time does the clock show?") and set_fill_in_blank for active clock setting and time representation ("Set the clock to show 9:30 p.m.").

competency_alignment.rationale: The content aligns strictly with the MATATAG learning competency without premature extension into elapsed time or multi-step word problems. Questions like "What time does the clock show?" and "Set the clock to show 9:40 a.m." faithfully assess the stated competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The values tested use realistic 12-hour clock times and standard minute intervals (e.g., "Set the clock to show 12:05 a.m.", "Set the clock to show 3:15 p.m.", and "Set the clock to show 11:30 a.m.") appropriate for Grade 2 students learning analog time with a.m. and p.m.
